mapper.select: SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , t1.fund_cd AS fundCd , ia.fund_nm AS fundNm , TO_CHAR(t1.bf_gyul_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bfGyulYmd , TO_CHAR(t1.bf_gyul_ymd + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bfStart , TO_CHAR(t1.af_gyul_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS afGyulYmd , TO_CHAR(t1.haeji_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS haejiYmd , TO_CHAR(t1.haeji_ymd - 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS af FROM SZM0GI t1 , SZM0IA ia WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND (TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN t1.bf_gyul_ymd + 1 AND t1.af_gyul_ymd OR ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), -12) BETWEEN t1.bf_gyul_ymd + 1 AND t1.af_gyul_ymd) AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd AND F_FUND_SUCCESS(#{corpGr}, t1.fund_cd, t1.af_gyul_ymd) = 'ok' ORDER BY t1.fund_cd ASC
